statements.quote: With this strong and growing demand for our Cloud products and services, we are increasing our investment in capital expenditures in 2025 to approximately $85 billion and are excited by the opportunity ahead.
statements.notes: Total 2025 capex guidance ('approximately $85 billion'), not an AI amount. The sentence names Cloud demand as the driver and does not mention AI; the AI link comes only from the surrounding sentences in the CEO quote. Recorded as scope total so the figure is not read as AI spend.
